name: Mail
description: Search, read, and draft replies in Apple Mail.

capabilities.name: Search Mail
capabilities.intent: Search emails by sender, subject, or content.
capabilities.script: Search the user's mailbox for messages matching the query.

capabilities.name: Read Current Message
capabilities.intent: Read the currently selected email message.
capabilities.script: Read and summarize the currently selected email in Mail.

capabilities.name: Unread Mail Count
capabilities.intent: Show the number of unread messages in the inbox.
capabilities.script: Count unread messages in the Mail inbox.

capabilities.name: Draft Reply
capabilities.intent: Draft a reply to the current message without sending.
capabilities.script: Draft a reply to the currently selected email. Show the draft for approval before sending.

capabilities.name: New Message
capabilities.intent: Open a new blank email compose window.
